$comment: Which side of the split each tracked file is on. WHY IT EXISTS: the design record calls for the public repository to be a mechanical projection of this one rather than a hand-copied subset, and a projection needs a boundary that a machine can compute. A LIST of what ships can omit a file silently; a PARTITION cannot, so `check_shipped_closure` requires every tracked file to be PLACED - matched by a rule, or computed from reachability if it is a script - and every rule to match a file. SCRIPTS ARE NOT LISTED HERE: their side is COMPUTED from reachability, seeded by the scripts SKILL.md tells an agent to run plus `consumer_seeds` below, so a script nobody can reach from the skill's own surface is development by default - the safe direction. FIELDS: `prefix` matches a path exactly, as a directory prefix, or - when it ends in `/` - the bare directory path itself; longest match wins; `side` is consumer or dev; `why` is the reason, because a boundary nobody can explain is a boundary nobody can maintain.
seeds_comment: Consumer-facing scripts SKILL.md does not name by path: the two the operator runs around a delivery (where it belongs, how it becomes a PDF), the corpus scorer, and the two embedders the deck scaffold calls. `scatter_svg` joins them at 0.1.665: DR-20 tells a reader this tool draws a scatter from a JSON spec, and a rule may not name a file the package omits — it shipped at 0.1.664 with zero callers and a published rule pointing at it.

dev_pins.why: reachable from the skill's surface ONLY through prose: geo_projection.py's docstring says the projection 'is held to them by a golden grid in scripts/check/check_globe.py'. Its one real caller is check_evidence.py, which executes it as the globe-js evidence command - a development script, which is the side this pin puts it on. 2,200 lines needing Playwright, and a package-integrity check rather than a deliverable one
reachable ONLY through prose: an error string in check_globe.py and two docstrings. It regenerates the shared-arc topology from source data no deliverable carries

pins_comment: Reachability cannot tell a CALL from a MENTION, and two development tools rode a docstring into the consumer half. A pin is auditable rather than trusted: check_shipped_closure requires that no consumer script IMPORTS a pinned stem, which is the half a mention cannot fake.
